content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Henderson

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's eligibility criteria—typically a bachelor's degree plus defined years of project leadership experience, or alternative combinations. Granite PM Academy's advisors can verify your qualifications before enrollment, ensuring you meet all prerequisites for exam candidacy.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® Certification Training course. Attend interactive sessions from anywhere in Henderson or beyond, learning core project-management domains alongside active certified practitioners. This structured coursework satisfies PMI's formal-education requirement and prepares you directly for exam content and real-world application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the 35-hour course, submit your official PMI application with proof of education and experience. Pay the associated examination fee directly to PMI. Our team guides you through the submission process to ensure accuracy and avoid delays in approval.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor Q&A—to consolidate your knowledge. Schedule your computer-based exam through Pearson Vue at a testing center convenient to your location. Our support continues right up to exam day to build your confidence.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP® credential remains valid for three years. During that cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through approved training, volunteering, or practice activities. Renew on schedule to keep your certification active and demonstrate your ongoing commitment to professional excellence in project management.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
